title: Align docs after the diff-review conversations removal: stale review-comment wording, and restore the host-write inventory
outcome: The docs no longer describe manual review comments or replies as current or planned, and the historical host-write inventory in host-architecture.md is accurate again for the commit it cites.
acceptance: docs/features/markdown-document-view.md no longer says the Changes view shows review comments, and docs/roadmap.md no longer lists saved review comments, agent review replies or mobile review comments as deliverables or scope; diff-review-workflow.md's acceptance criteria are labelled historical or dropped.

The host-architecture.md case study that inventories commit 28e9ed5's host-write call sites again lists api_review.rs (2) with its original totals, noting that those sites were later removed with the feature, so the inventory matches the commit it names.
